# Exercise-by-exercise audit

Reviewed every one of 24 lessons and 72 exercise instructions at fresh-clone commit `dcb8914`; this is not a claim of 72 finished student projects.

Fixed 14 exercise instructions across 11 lessons, plus QA-capstone, delegation-template and research-pack gaps.

Confirmed from fresh clone: seeded router five-test expected failure; repaired router seven passing checks; all three mutants rejected; normal demo; intentional crash exit3; resume one draft/one write; trace inspection. Verified all research cost/count arithmetic, lesson15 budget arithmetic, and lesson22 outcome denominators.

## Interpretation

Every instruction, fixture requirement, deliverable and pass criterion was reviewed. Rows marked manual are reasoned checks, not claims that a student completed an original project. The real MCP, installed-skill and composed-harness runs are recorded in the [final student audit](STUDENT-AUDIT.md). Live-model quality, optional description A/B experiments, and a real learner pilot remain separate work.
